role: Developer reference describing the overnight HRV recording pipeline (data model, pause/resume, morning processing, scoring, charts, migrations, UI data flow, mutation contract, sleep editor, notifications, HealthKit export), the Fitness workout pipeline, route awareness, training-load math and the AI dispatch path.
toplevel: Markdown only; no executable content. Code blocks are pseudo-code flow descriptions.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference
units.does: no behavioural claim: document title.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 1. Data Model
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header for the data model subsections.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 1. Data Model > RRPoint
units.does: Claims RRPoint holds t_ms (cumulative sum of prior RR, not wall time), rr_ms, optional wallClockMs (streaming only, gap-aware), optional hr (streaming only), and computed endMs = t_ms + rr_ms; beats dropped on BLE disconnect leave no gap in t_ms while wallClockMs advances. Matches RRModels.swift:4-54 and PolarManager appendStreamedBeat.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 1. Data Model > RRSeries
units.does: Claims RRSeries = points + sessionId + startDate, and that startDate + t_ms/1000 gives cumulative time while startDate + wallClockMs/1000 gives gap-aware time. Matches RRModels.swift:71-74.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 1. Data Model > HRVSession
units.does: Lists HRVSession fields: id/startDate/endDate/state (.collecting/.analyzing/.complete/.paused/.failed), sessionType (.overnight/.nap/.quick/.breathe/.workout), rrSeries, analysisResult, sleepStartMs/sleepEndMs, sleepSegments, linkedSessionIds, pausedDate, dataSourceSummary, sleepSnapshot and vitalsSnapshot frozen at acceptance, recoveryScore on 0-10 scale. Enum cases and fields match SessionMetadata.swift:68-73, :145-198, :384-390.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 1. Data Model > SessionArchiveEntry (in-memory index)
units.does: Claims SessionArchiveEntry index fields (sessionId, date, endDate, fileHash, filePath, recoveryScore, meanRMSSD, meanHR/stressIndex backfilled by migrateMetrics, meanSDNN, tags, notes, sessionType, linkedSessionIds) and that retrieveLightweight skips rrSeries for dashboard/history/paused search. Fields match SessionMetadata.swift:710-732 (doc omits later sleepEnd/sleepSegmentCount/stage-minute fields); migrateMetrics backfills meanHR/stressIndex.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 2. Recording Phase
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header for recording phase.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 2. Recording Phase > Start: `startOvernightStreaming()`
units.does: Claims tapping Record creates an overnight HRVSession dated now, starts BLE streaming via PolarManager, resets the cumulative counter and runs a 1 s timer for the elapsed clock and incremental backup. Code: startOvernightStreaming takes sessionType (.overnight or .nap), starts streaming, launches the H10 internal-recording loop when backup is on and device is not Verity Sense, starts HealthKit sleep/vitals observers, persists recording state and starts a 1 Hz timer (tolerance 0.25 s) doing backup + battery staleness checks.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 2. Recording Phase > Streaming data arrives: PolarManager (`PolarManager+Streaming.swift`, the stream
units.does: Claims each streamed RR sample becomes RRPoint(t_ms: running cumulative, rr_ms, wallClockMs: ms since stream start, hr) appended to _streamedRRPoints and the cumulative counter advances by rr. Code matches (appendStreamedBeat); additionally zero intervals are skipped, a safety cap stops appends, Verity Sense PPI goes through StrapPPIFilter, and all beats in one BLE batch share the batch-arrival wallClockMs. Ingestion is via StrapHRSample from the strap HR service, not a per-sample Polar SDK callback.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 3. Pause/Resume Flow
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header for pause/resume.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 3. Pause/Resume Flow > Pause: `pauseOvernightStreaming()`
units.does: Claims Pause runs gatherOvernightData → mergeParentSessionData → processOvernightData, marks the session .paused with pausedDate, archives it and persists the paused id to UserDefaults. Code matches for the full-analysis path; when gather returns nil (insufficient data) a short-recording path saves the raw beats merged with the parent without analysis, which the doc omits.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 3. Pause/Resume Flow > Resume: `resumeOvernightStreaming(linkedSessionId:)`
units.does: Claims Resume creates a new HRVSession linked to the parent, appends the child id to the parent in the archive, restarts streaming with the counter reset to 0, clears collectedPoints and sets pausedBeatCount to the parent's count for display. Code matches; it also inherits the parent's sessionType, relaunches the H10 backup loop when applicable, and links the child only after streaming starts successfully.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 3. Pause/Resume Flow > Finalize: `finalizeFromPause()`
units.does: Claims Done-without-resume sets state .complete, re-archives and sets needsAcceptance = true.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 4. Stop/Morning Processing
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header for stop/morning processing.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 4. Stop/Morning Processing > Stop: `stopOvernightStreaming()`
units.does: Claims Stop tears down streaming, backs up beats, then with >=120 streamed beats (any beats for a resumed child) downloads the strap recording concurrently with HealthKit sleep (no strap fetch for Verity Sense), picks a source and runs mergeParentSessionData → processOvernightData; otherwise falls back to a strap-primary fetch that fails the session when barred or < 120 beats. Code matches (minimumUsableBeats = 120, hasValidStreaming, fallbackToDeviceFetch).

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 4. Stop/Morning Processing > gatherOvernightData() (pause path, `RRCollector+PauseResume.swift`)
units.does: Claims gatherOvernightData (in RRCollector+PauseResume.swift) stops the streaming timer and background audio, captures stopStreaming() points, backs up raw data, optionally fetches the H10 recording, picks streaming/internal/composite and returns OvernightDataResult.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 4. Stop/Morning Processing > mergeParentSessionData()
units.does: Claims that when the session has a parent id and the parent has RR data in the archive, child t_ms and wallClockMs are shifted by (child.startDate − parent.startDate) ms, merged = parent.points + shifted child, and the merged base session takes the parent's startDate. Code matches; additionally a non-positive or unrepresentable offset refuses the merge and returns the child alone.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 5. processOvernightData() — The Main Pipeline
units.does: Claims the morning pipeline: backup, build series, same-night merge only for overnights with sessionMergeMode != .off, skipping already-linked sessions and keeping only segments within the merge gap of the base chain (segmentsWithinGap; Default 4.5 h or Custom), artifact detection, verification, HealthKit sleep (cache-first via SleepDataCache, 14 entries, ±1 day, else bounded poll 15×2 s), sleep-stage classification, training load, window selection with Tier-1 ranking and wall-clock→t_ms translation, organized zones, HRV analysis, final session, recovery score, supersede same-night, archive. Code: RRCollector wrapper fetches training load first, then MorningProcessingService.run does backup → buildMergedSeries → artifacts/verify → sleep poll → window → analysis → vitals snapshot → insufficient-data gate → score → supersede; the wrapper archives via archiveForReview.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 6. Recovery Score Calculation (scoring version v3.2.oct2026)
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header naming scoring version v3.2.oct2026 (matches ScoringVersion.current).

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 6. Recovery Score Calculation (scoring version v3.2.oct2026) > RecoveryScoreCalculator (RecoveryScoreCalculator.swift)
units.does: Claims the score is HRV+Sleep+Vitals with training load excluded; Tier 1 SWC band (z=-3→5, -1.5→25, -0.75→64, -0.5…+0.5→72, +1.5→90) plus DFA/RHR/CV/ANS adjustments and staleness penalty; Tier 2 sleep sub-weights 35/25/25/15, HRV 70/Sleep 30, dampened to 85/15 when z<-1 and sleep<50; Tier 3 60/25/15 with vitals mean of RHR (-10/SD), RR (-15/br/min beyond ±1, population 12-18 fallback, below 12 → 90), temp (≤0.3→100, ≤0.5→75, ≤1.0→50, >1.0→25, positive only); Respiratory/WristTemperature baseline caches with 30-day TTL; Comeback 80/20/0; SpO2 <95 % → −10. All numbers match ScoringWeights, scoringParametersV2 and ScoreDetailBuilder.buildTier2.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 6. Recovery Score Calculation (scoring version v3.2.oct2026) > Training Load (Load & Trajectory surface — does NOT feed the recovery score)
units.does: Claims training load (Banister TRIMP, ATL 7 d / CTL 42 d / TSB, ACWR labels, Foster monotony banner when monotony > 2.0 AND strain > 200) is shown on Load & Trajectory / Training Detail and frozen into analysisResult.trainingContext, not the score.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 7. Chart Display
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header for chart display.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 7. Chart Display > OvernightChartsView
units.does: Claims computeOvernightStats resolves sleep boundaries, computes sleep-bounded and full HR values, rolling RMSSD on 5-min windows stepping 30 beats, peak HRV in the 30-70 % band, and sleep duration; Canvas X axis is t_ms relative to firstMs/lastMs endMs; line breaks when consecutive points are > 300 000 ms apart; x labels from series.startDate/actualEndDate; window overlay by ms; organized zones from analysisResult or computeOrganizedZonesOnDemand without rewriting the archive.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 7. Chart Display > Key chart rendering detail:
units.does: Worked example: with correctly offset child t_ms the chart shows segment 1, a > 5 min gap with no line, then segment 2; without the offset both segments overlap in x. Consistent with the 300 000 ms segment split and childPointsOffsetToParent.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 8. Where Segments Get Combined (Summary)
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header stating there are two merge paths.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 8. Where Segments Get Combined (Summary) > Path A: Pause/Resume (mergeParentSessionData)
units.does: Claims Path A (pause/resume) merges parent + offset child via mergeParentSessionData in stop/pause before processOvernightData. Matches pauseWithFullAnalysis and analyzeAndFinalizeOvernight.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 8. Where Segments Get Combined (Summary) > Path B: Same-Night Separate Sessions (processOvernightData)
units.does: Claims Path B merges independent same-night overnight sessions inside processOvernightData, sorted and offset from the earliest start, skipping sessions in linkedSessionIds. Code also skips ids linked from any same-night entry and limits to the merge gap / mode.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 8. Where Segments Get Combined (Summary) > The interaction:
units.does: Claims for a pause/resumed session Path A runs first, Path B then skips the parent (linked) and may still find other independent same-night sessions. Matches sameNightSegments' alreadyLinked filter.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 9. Full Session Lifecycle
units.does: Lifecycle walkthrough of continuous, pause/resume, independent same-night and crash-recovery cases. Option D: findRecoverableArchivedSession searches overnight entries < 24 h old with meanRMSSD nil or recoveryScore ≤ 1.0 and returns the candidate only when exactly one matches; with several it logs the ambiguity (logAmbiguousRecoveryCandidates) and returns nil, and the strap file is filed by its own start; with one, the download reuses that session's id and rewrites the placeholder.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 10. HR-Estimated Sleep (fallback)
units.does: Claims HR-estimated sleep runs only when HealthKit returns 0 minutes: RR-based estimateSleepFromHR first, then HealthKit HR over the window extended to the schedule end with 20-min smoothing, ≥ 8 bpm range, threshold max − 0.5·range, onset on 2 consecutive points (kept within 20 min after bedtime, else bedtime), wake at end of last below-threshold block, ≥ 12 samples and ≥ 120 min; live sessions keep loading when nothing found; AutoSleepExtension is never constructed in production. Matches MorningResultsViewModel and HRSleepEstimator.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 11. App Startup & Deferred Migrations
units.does: Claims startup: RRCollector.init loads the index, rebuilds baseline if daysCollected == 0, sets up bindings/observers, restores paused state and recent paused session off-main, runs repairMergeDataLoss gated by a flag; housekeeping phase runs archive.runDeferredMigrations (reencrypt, recoveryScores, endDates, metrics, sleepIndexFields, removeDuplicates, relinkSameNightSessions) and SessionDataMigrations.runAllIfNeeded (InsufficientData, TrainingRecalibration, TrimpRepair, WorkoutSleepCleanup, NapRepair, TimeInBedRepair) with the listed UserDefaults flags. Migration order, flag keys and skip rules match code; parity test files exist.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 11a. UI Session Data Flow
units.does: Claims MainTabView owns the dashboard slice (seeded count, 50 ms reload guard), TrendsV2View/HistoryView load independently, every view observes RRCollector.archiveVersion and CloudKitSyncManager.pullVersion, dashboard loads recentSessionsAsync(limit: 35), Trends loads limit nil then filters overnight/analysisResult/isReliableForHRVAggregates in TimeRange 7/14/30/90/all, History uses archive.entries; mutation paths call notifyArchiveChanged. Dashboard numbers match (dashboardSessionLoadLimit 35, 0.05 s guard).

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 12. Key Files Reference
units.does: Key-files table mapping pipeline responsibilities to files. All listed files exist, but several mappings are stale: gatherOvernightData is in RRCollector+OvernightGather.swift (not +OvernightStreaming), RRPoint creation is in PolarManager+Streaming.swift, and the HRVSession struct is declared in SessionMetadata.swift (HRVSession.swift holds decoding support).

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 13. Post-Acceptance Mutation Contract
units.does: Claims an archived session is frozen except for explicit user actions, the one-shot launch migrations, the automatic sleep refresh of today's session, and additive fill-in merges of late HealthKit data.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 13. Post-Acceptance Mutation Contract > 13.1 User-initiated mutations (full-overwrite allowed)
units.does: Lists full-overwrite mutation paths: reanalyzeSession, retroApplySleepSettings, applyManualAnalysis, updateSessionSleepBoundaries (timeline Done), repairTrainingSnapshots (Troubleshooting → Advanced Diagnostics, and once at launch via runTrimpRepairMigrationIfNeeded), the launch one-shot migrations (SessionDataMigrations.runAllIfNeeded: InsufficientData rescore, TrainingRecalibration and TrimpRepair rewrite training snapshot and frozen readiness only, WorkoutSleepCleanup strips workout sleep snapshots, NapRepair and TimeInBed recompute scores), SessionRecoveryService fallback, CloudKit merge, session resume.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 13. Post-Acceptance Mutation Contract > 13.2 Automatic additive-merge paths (fill-in-only)
units.does: Claims automatic paths: RecoveryScoreDetailView vitals refresh (on open and on each MorningCoordination.vitalsDataVersion bump while open) fills nil vitalsSnapshot fields via RecoveryVitalsBackfill with strap RHR winning, the only path that writes late vitals (no dashboard refresh; VitalsDetailV2View re-fetches for display only); any non-nil frozen sleepSnapshot is used unchanged at scoring (MorningProcessingService.scoringHealthData), HK fetched only when absent, nothing heals an empty snapshot except autoRefreshTodaysSleepIfImproved for today's session; autoRefreshTodaysSleepIfImproved (skips when sleepUserAdjusted, rewrites sleepSnapshot on improvement, posts .flowRecoveryRescoreNeeded on ≥ 20 min delta or first snapshot); installRescoreListener reanalyzes and records PendingScoreChange.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 13. Post-Acceptance Mutation Contract > 13.3 Integrity contract
units.does: Claims past sessions reopen with identical recoveryScore/scoreBreakdown/frozenReadiness/trainingSnapshot (launch migrations aside); today's session is rescored on every HK sleep bump that passes SleepRefreshPolicy.sleepRefreshVerdict (≥ 20 min, onset move, source upgrade to Watch, first snapshot) with no once-only guard; the banner is written only for a displayed change of 3 or more (recordPendingScoreChangeIfMeaningful), smaller changes apply silently; loading never rescores; cites SessionImmutabilityTests.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 14. Sleep Timeline Editor
units.does: Claims SleepDetailV2View presents SleepTimelineEditorView: canvas bars, 5-min snapped drags with 44 pt targets, split/carve/merge/delete, long-press add, 5-entry undo; Done builds SleepData via SleepScienceAnalyzer.buildSleepDataFromTimelineState (re-splits by awake, unspecified intervals count to total only) then updateSessionSleepBoundaries(isUserAdjustment: true) sets sleepUserAdjusted, rescores, archives and fires onArchiveChanged; provenance enum .watch/.iphone/.hrvDerived/.userAdded/.userCarved. Code matches (undo limit 5, 5*60 s step, 44 pt); the provenance enum also has .userAdjusted, which the doc omits.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 15. Morning Feeling & Divergence Narrative
units.does: Claims the dashboard morning-feeling prompt (5 emoji, 1 s cancellable commit, tags when ≤ 2: Body Infection/Allergies/Hangover/Stomach/Sore/Tired/Headache, Mind Stressed/Down) writes via viewModel.updateMorningFeeling onto the HRVSession, and AnalysisSummaryGenerator.feelBadAdvice detects divergence and appends per-tag advice to the summary.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 16. Archive Status Visibility
units.does: Claims an interrupted recording surfaces as the launch 'Session Interrupted' alert (EmuquApp.interruptedSessionAlerts: Resume / Save as Complete / Dismiss, or Save to Archive / Dismiss when not resumable; Dismiss only marks it dismissed and the backup stays for Settings → iCloud & Data → Recover Lost Sessions), with no dashboard banner; the dashboard shows ScoreChangedBanner (primary/orange tint, written by recordPendingScoreChangeIfMeaningful at ≥ 3 points, cleared on X or after one read, live via .pendingScoreChangeWritten) and an ArchiveStatusLine pill on the recovery card; Settings → iCloud & Data storage summary and Force iCloud Sync; Repair Training History behind Advanced Diagnostics, which also runs once at launch via runTrimpRepairMigrationIfNeeded.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 16. Archive Status Visibility > Morning notification scheduling
units.does: Claims a repeating UNCalendarNotificationTrigger at dailyReportFixedTime plus, in Smart delivery, an immediate push from the sleep observer when the freshest sleep end is within 90 min and none sent today (UserDefaults date flag). Code matches and additionally requires the wake to fall within 7 h before the schedule's morning cutoff (isMorningWake) and notification authorization.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 16. Archive Status Visibility > Known Deferred
units.does: Lists deferred features: a 14-day re-engagement push (lastOvernightSessionDate not implemented — grep finds no such field) and A/B push format beyond 'Auto = teaser for first 30 sessions, full readout from 31+'.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 17. HealthKit Export (Write-Back)
units.does: Claims exportSessionMetrics writes windowed SDNN, per-minute HR samples, one nocturnal-median RHR per day, and sleep only when HR-estimated, each gated by its export setting and isolated by its own do/catch. Code matches; it also skips HealthKit-sourced sessions and re-checks for another sleep source before writing.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 18. Fitness Tab — Workout Recording Pipeline
units.does: Claims the live-workout pipeline: start() reconnects known secondary sensors, starts strap streaming, GPS/altimeter (lazy WorkoutLocationManager), pedometer, foot pod/PM5/FTMS, Watch session, α1 analyzer, voice coach, Zwift broadcast and a 1 Hz ticker; each tick ingests RR into LiveDFAAnalyzer (2-min window, 20 s cadence), backs up incrementally, records samples, auto-detects a saved route after 500 m (150 m start reject, ≤ 30 m mean nearest-neighbour), updates threshold breach counters, refreshes weather (30 min TTL, 5 km) and road geocoding (15 m / 60 s, 8-failure backoff, 30 s retry), publishes a LiveWorkoutSnapshot, pushes Watch/Zwift state, runs voice-coach/turn/mile-marker engines (turn bands 150/60/25 m) and the interval controller; stop() snapshots RR without stopping the stream, tears down live services, finalizes via WorkoutAnalyzer (Banister male 0.64/1.92, female 0.86/1.67, hrTSS, power metrics, splits), archives a breadcrumb trail (50-trail cap), disconnects the foot pod, flips to .finished and runs detached HRR capture (+60/+120 s strap) before stopping and disconnecting the strap. Constants checked match code.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 18. Fitness Tab — Workout Recording Pipeline > Post-summary cards data flow
units.does: Claims FitnessPostSummaryView cards read workoutMetadata: headline stats, route map, HRR card, charts, α1 timeline (0.75/0.50), route by α1 band, an α1 LT1 estimate shown only (deliberately no LTHR update suggestion, as ThresholdCards+Cards.swift states), threshold crossings, zone distribution, derived metrics, physiology, splits, GPX/CSV/TCX export.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 18a. Route Awareness Pipeline (where road names and turn cues come from)
units.does: Claims RoadAwarenessEngine.snap refuses to snap unless course accuracy and speed ≥ 0.7 m/s pass, fetches a RoadGraphService tile (250 m cells, 800 m radius, 6 h TTL, coalesced, 1.1 s gap, 8 s timeout), snaps with confidence 0.7·distance + 0.3·bearing agreement, walks ahead 600 m / 3 intersections, never invents a name; RoadGeocodingService uses MKLocalSearch then CLGeocoder (5 s, 30 s recovery after 8 failures), cross-street search over radii 200/500/1500/3000 m, 15 m / 60 s gates.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 18b. Fitness — Retroactive Repair Actions
units.does: Claims two summary-sheet repairs: real-elevation lookup via TopoElevationService (≤ 100 samples, NED 10 m in US else SRTM 30 m, 15 m sustained-climb threshold, preview then write + notifyArchiveChanged) and α1 re-analysis (2-min windows at 20 s, Kubios-style ±20 % vs 5-beat median with interpolation, nearest-in-time replacement, early samples cleared). Constants match TopoElevationService, WorkoutAlpha1Reanalyzer and LiveDFAAnalyzer.cleanRRForDFA (which also rejects RR < 300 or > 2000 ms).

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 18c. Elevation capture — pro-grade barometric pipeline
units.does: Claims barometric samples are buffered unthresholded during recording and at finalize BarometricAltitudeProcessor applies a 15-sample symmetric moving average and 2 m hysteresis to compute gain/loss, falling back to GPS gain when no barometer; retroactive repair via TopoElevationService. Constants match BarometricAltitudeProcessor (window 15, 2.0 m).

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 19. Training Load Math (Research Citations)
units.does: Claims Banister TRIMP per beat with sex coefficients (ranges 0-4.37 / 0-4.57 per min), Edwards fallback when HRrest unknown, hrTSS = session TRIMP / 1 h at LTHR TRIMP × 100 returning nil if HRmax, HRrest or LTHR missing, LTHR = override else 0.88 × max HR, and the UI surfaces the α1 LT1 estimate as a suggested override.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 20. AI Dispatch Flow
units.does: no behavioural claim: section intro pointing to docs/VOICE_AND_TOOL_USE.md for rationale.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 20. AI Dispatch Flow > Entry point
units.does: Claims every send trims text, sets nextSendIsVoice, appends the user turn, then tries DeterministicIntent.tryMatch (14-pattern catalog) and on a hit appends the reply, records deterministic_hit telemetry and skips the LLM.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 20. AI Dispatch Flow > Provider resolution
units.does: Claims routing: non-Apple selection or Manual → user's pick; voice with Apple selected → first available consented cloud (default model) else Apple; Quick/Deep pin the tier, Auto uses SmartProviderRouter (bumping session tier/turn count); Deep with a cloud mapping is capped at 50/day then downgraded to .auto; TierProviderMapper quick → Apple, auto → consented Grok then DeepSeek else Apple, deep → same mid-tier cloud; action-intent override moves tool-needing turns off Apple to the first consented cloud. Matches TurnRouter, SmartProviderRouter.dailyTier3Cap = 50 and TierProviderMapper.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 20. AI Dispatch Flow > Capability classification (Auto mode)
units.does: Claims CapabilityClassifier: keyword heuristic per axis, gated AND with NLContextualEmbedding cosine ≥ 0.55 per axis when available, else keyword-only; 0/1/≥2 flags → quick/auto/deep; stickiness: upgrades always, first 3 turns follow proposal, quick with no flags escapes, else keep current tier. Matches code; additionally non-English input opens every keyword gate and with no embedder returns no flags, and an NLEmbedding word-vector fallback exists.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 20. AI Dispatch Flow > Apple Foundation send (Quick tier)
units.does: Claims the Apple path sets AppleToolDispatcher's registry, strips the cache marker, compacts history to 0.70 × 4096 minus system tokens keeping the latest user turn, wraps tools via AppleToolCatalog, reuses a cached LanguageModelSession unless instructions/tool hash change, ≥ 20 turns, a fresh conversation or token overflow, streams with maximumResponseTokens 512 yielding text deltas. Constants match AppleContextCompactor (0.70, 4096, responseReserve 512) and SessionCache.maxTurnsPerSession = 20.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 20. AI Dispatch Flow > Tool-call resolution path (Apple)
units.does: Claims Apple tool calls go AppleToolAdapter.call → AppleToolDispatcher.dispatch, which returns an explicit no-registry error JSON when unset, else CompactToolRouter.resolveTool and toToolResultJSON. Matches; dispatch also refuses web_search on the Apple path and enforces the per-turn call budget and output allowance.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 20. AI Dispatch Flow > Cloud provider send (Auto / Deep tier)
units.does: Claims cloud sends build provider-specific bodies (Anthropic cache_control 1 h on tools/system/last turn with a <live_state> block appended to the last user message; OpenAI-compatible function calling; Gemini function_declarations), loop up to 8 tool calls per turn (AssistantViewModel.maxToolCallsPerTurn), and record .usage into LLMCacheTelemetry.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 20. AI Dispatch Flow > Telemetry sinks
units.does: Claims usage events feed LLMCacheTelemetry (cumulative and last-10 rolling hit ratios) shown in Settings → Troubleshooting AI cache health card, SmartProviderRouter keeps in-memory tier/proposal/stickiness counters, and nothing is persisted or sent off-device. Matches LLMCacheTelemetry (recentHitRatio turns: 10) and recordTelemetry; LLMRequestAudit is also in-memory only.

units.key: § Emuqu — Complete Data Flow Reference > 20. AI Dispatch Flow > Voice preamble (model identity earcon)
units.does: Claims the first voice reply of a session is prefixed 'Flo here. <Model>.' (or 'Flo here.' with no provider), workout coach uses 'Coach here.'. Matches announced(); scripted/trigger speech skips the preamble.
